You write what you want to leave behind in the old year, in up to 120 characters, and your paper burns in a shared fire together with thousands of others. No, the fire is digital: a computer animation on our website and on our YouTube live stream. No real paper is burned and nothing is sent to you by post. What is real is the moment: you, and many others, letting something go together.

q: How fast will my paper burn?
a: Within minutes of payment your paper appears in the fire on the website, and your personal page opens right away. From 20 to 31 December papers also appear on the live stream in the order they were paid. Midnight fire papers wait for the final minutes of 31 December.
Only if you allow it and it passes our check. You can choose to keep your text private: your paper still burns, only its number is shown. Your text is always visible to you on your personal page.

The fire is public, and the people you name never agreed to appear on a live stream. So we don't show names of real people, phone numbers, links or insults. If your text contains them, your paper still burns, but the text is hidden from public view.

q: How does payment work? Is it safe?
a: You pay on the bank's own secure payment page, not on our site, and your bank may ask for a confirmation code. We never see or store your card number. Your order is marked as paid only after the bank confirms the payment to us directly.
Visa, Mastercard and ArCa cards accepted by our partner bank; the exact list is shown on the bank's payment page. Idram may be added later. Prices are final and shown in AMD.

q: Can I pay from abroad or from Russia?
a: Yes, most foreign cards work: you are charged in AMD and your bank converts the amount, sometimes with a small fee. Cards issued in Russia generally don't work with Armenian banks. In that case a relative or friend in Armenia can pay for you using the link to your order.

q: Where does the 20% go, and why?
a: From every payment we set aside 20% for New Year gifts for children in Armenian orphanages. We will name the orphanage(s) before 15 December 2026, buy and deliver the gifts between 6 and 13 January 2027, and publish the receipts and a report on the site. We do it because a New Year ritual that thinks only of itself felt wrong to us.

No, and we want to be honest about it. We are a for-profit company, and you are paying for a digital service. Giving 20% to children's gifts is our own choice, so it is not a donation from you and it is not tax-deductible.

With "Burn + 2027 wish" and "Midnight fire" you also write a wish for next year, up to 200 characters. We keep it privately for a year, and on 31 December 2027 we open the wishes on a live stream; you see your own wish on your personal page. If you leave an email, we will remind you.

You write a paper on behalf of someone close to you and add just their first name. You get a link to send them, so they can watch their paper burn and keep the image. Please share the link only with that person.
